pairs.subject: embedded-preview
pairs.evidence: src/app/preview/PreviewMount.tsx:92 The /preview harness mounts the host's own first-party section components in its own React tree (no frame, no guest server, no bridge), which is the 'same-origin, first-party embed' case the golden path excludes; searches of src/ for postMessage, iframe, contentWindow, MessageEvent and targetOrigin found no hits (and none in the context's directories).

techniques.evidence: src/app/preview/PreviewMount.tsx:85 Section is created in-tree via createElement; there is no frame or message channel, so there is nothing to correlate.
src/app/preview/registry.ts:19 The previewed content is the host's own production components, so there is no foreign origin and no inbound or outbound messages to validate.
src/app/preview/[section]/page.tsx:16 Preview is a route of the host's own Next dev server and 404s in production; no guest server is spawned or owned.

src/app/_dev-inspector/DevInspector.tsx:18 DevInspector instruments the host itself, not a guest. It does match the spirit (dev-gated, degrades to a HUD hint when no data-loc stamps exist), but it is not a guest agent.

src/app/preview/derive.ts:46 Slugs are derived from the host's own Lazy* exports, not from a guest's file tree. This matches the technique's spirit (derived, not hand-listed, pinned by registry.test.ts), but no guest exists.
src/app/preview/page.tsx:11 The host never mutates a guest between views (this is a static dev-only review page), so there are no mutation boundaries to checkpoint.
